description: For the relation \(n=c\) and a bound \(b\le c\), bounded search returns its sentinel \(b\), while unbounded search returns \(c\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.PartialRecursiveFunctions.bound_can_miss_later_witness (b c : ℕ) (hbc : b ≤ c) :
  have P := fun x => List.Vector.get x 0 = c;
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PartialRecursiveFunctions.boundedPredicateSearch P List.Vector.nil b = b ∧
    c ∈ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PartialRecursiveFunctions.predicateSearch P List.Vector.nil
